# FOSS Club SRM KTR

> The official Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) Club at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Kattankulathur (KTR), Chennai.

Official student chapter of FOSS United Foundation (https://fossunited.org/c/srm-ktr). Dedicated to promoting open-source software, upstream contributions, hackathons, Linux kernel internals, Rust tooling, and student developer communities.

## Core Navigation
- [Homepage](/): Club vision, core technical initiatives, interactive 3D tech showcase, and featured events.
- [Events & Hackathons](/events): Upcoming and past hackathons, Linux bootcamps, developer sprints, and registration portals.
- [Core Team & Contributors](/team): Student leadership, technical maintainers, corporate leads, and creative contributors.
- [Recruitments & Applications](/recruitments): Annual recruitment cycles across Technical, Corporate, and Creative tracks.
